# PRD: Dashboard refresh

## Goal
We want to modernise the analytics dashboard so it feels faster and more delightful, and better reflects the brand.

## Context
The current dashboard is dated. Stakeholders have asked for a refresh that customers will love. The team should use good judgement on layout and polish.

## Notes
See the design inspiration deck. Ship when it feels ready.
